name: CHRUNCHEX
ingredients_raw: POTATO (88%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALMOLEIN), SUGAR, EDIBLE - COMMON SALT, MALTODEXTRIN, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (CHILLI (0.5%), PEPPER), DEHYDRATED VEGETABLE POWDER (ONION, GARLIC (0.1%), TOMATO), MILK SOLIDS (WHEY) (0.1%), HYDROLYZED VEGETABLE PROTÉIN (SOYA), ACIDITY REGULATOR (INS 296, INS 334), ANTICAKING AGENT (INS 551), MINERAL SALT (INS 340), PAPRIKA EXTRACT (INS 160C), FLAVOUR ENHANCER (INS 627, INS 631), NATURAL & NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CHILLI).
